description.zh:
采用异步消息链路重新运行作业。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use an asynchronous link to rerun the job.

Default value: false

description.zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用[ListClusters](~~87116~~)获取集群ID。
description.en:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to query the cluster ID.

description.zh:
需要重新运行的作业ID列表，作业数量取值范围：1~100。

格式为`[{"Id": "0.sched****"},{"Id": "1.sched****"}]`，多个作业间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

您可以调用[ListJobs](~~87251~~)查询作业ID。

>需要重新运行的作业状态必须为RUNNING或QUEUED。
description.en:
The list of jobs that you want to run. Maximum number of jobs: 100. Minimum number of jobs: 1.

Format: `[{"Id": "0.sched****"},{"Id": "1.sched****"}]`. Separate multiple jobs with commas (,).

You can call the [ListJobs](~~87251~~) operation to query the job ID.

>  You can rerun only jobs that are in the RUNNING or QUEUED state.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc rerun-jobs --cluster-id ehpc-sh-3VeFyR0000 --jobs Id_:_1.scheduler --async false --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
